aiSummary: In October 2026, Google led search engines (mobile) in South Africa at 96.54% (market share of tracked page views / usage). bing ranked second at 2.8%, followed by Petal Search at 0.36%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engines (mobile) in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Google leads at 96.54% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-market-share/mobile/south-africa.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engines (mobile) in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Google (96.54%), bing (2.8%), Petal Search (0.36%) in October 2026.
